shift_1.notes:
Welcome to Exit 13. Night shift runs 10 PM to 6 AM.

Your tasks tonight:
- Familiarize yourself with the plaza
- Keep the shop running
- Check in any motel guests
- Authorize fuel pumps as needed
- Don't forget to brew coffee

Previous auditor quit without notice. No reason given.
Keys are on the hook behind the counter.
Breaker room is down the utility hall - key is in the desk drawer.

Good luck.
- Management

shift_2.notes:
Shift 2 notes:

Delivery scheduled around 2 AM. Sign for it.
One guest complaint about noise in Room 3 last night.
No one was in Room 3.

Radio has been acting up. Ignore the static.
Don't prop open the utility door.

- Management
shift_2.special_instructions: First horror events begin this shift

shift_3.notes:
Shift 3 notes:

Storm advisory for tonight. Secure outdoor items.
Guest in Room 5 extended another night.
Found old tapes in the office drawer. Not sure whose they are.

Someone called asking about Room 4.
Room 4 has been closed for years. Don't know how they got this number.

- Management
shift_3.special_instructions: Room 4 mystery deepens. Cassette tape available.

shift_4.notes:
Shift 4 notes:

Power outage reported on the highway last night. May affect us.
Backup generator needs fuel check.

Deputy Hale may stop by. Be cooperative.

DO NOT go into the basement storage.
Water damage. Structural concerns.

- Management
shift_4.special_instructions: Police involvement begins. Basement becomes accessible.

shift_5.notes:
Shift 5 notes:

Concerned about recent incidents.
If anything unusual happens, log it in the incident book.
Don't call the police for every noise.

New locks ordered for Rooms 3 and 6.
Don't ask why.

- Management
shift_5.special_instructions: Story branches emerge. Key choices presented.

shift_6.notes:
Shift 6 notes:

Ranger Owens will be doing a perimeter check tonight.
Cooperate but don't volunteer information.

The radio voice is NOT an emergency frequency.
Do not respond to it.

- Management
shift_6.special_instructions: Radio voice becomes interactive. Trust decisions.

shift_7.notes:
Shift 7 notes:

I know you've been asking questions.
Stop.
Do your job. Go home. Come back.

That's all this needs to be.

- Management
